title: The Very Nearly Right Theory of Flavor
summary: A striking empirical observation about the CKM matrix is that the angles of the unitarity triangle $(α, β, γ)$ are very close to $(π/2, π/8, 3 π/8) $, simple fractions of $π$ that are suggestive of an underlying theory linking flavor and spontaneous CP violation. However, relating this empirical observation to an underlying theory of flavor is challenging, since the unitarity triangle is a complicated function of the Yukawa matrices.
